name: architecture-requirements
description: Create, refine, and review software architecture requirements and system design documents.

interface.longDescription: Turn product requirements into an architecture document: drivers, components, APIs, data models, integrations, security, performance, scalability, reliability, and architecture decision records (ADRs). Works step by step with you: proposes a design, shows a diagram, and asks one blocking decision at a time.
defaultPrompt: Turn this PRD into a technical design
Propose an architecture for a personal expense tracking app
Review this architecture for gaps and risks
